category: evidence-backed Search and AI discoverability operations
northStar: Real sites completing a reviewed loop from intended outcome through observed site state, applicable change, verified deployment and provider-native Search or AI evidence to an explicit keep, revise, continue, revert or retire decision.

proofFirstMilestone.goal: Demonstrate trustworthy end-to-end evidence loops before expanding major product or protocol scope.

publicJourney.label: Tell Goose the goal
publicJourney.question: Who is this site for, what useful outcome should it create, and what boundaries matter?

publicJourney.label: Inspect
publicJourney.question: What does the real public site and source repository actually expose?

publicJourney.label: Decide
publicJourney.question: What are the top one to three evidence-backed moves that actually apply?

publicJourney.label: Change
publicJourney.question: Which changes can be made safely, deterministically and reviewably?

publicJourney.label: Prove
publicJourney.question: Is the intended implementation really live, and what external evidence followed?

publicJourney.label: Watch / revise
publicJourney.question: What changed in upstream guidance, site state or outcomes, and what now needs re-review?

google.primaryAiEvidence: generative-AI Search/Discover impressions and visible-page dimensions from owner Search Console reports

bing.primaryAiEvidence: AI citations, cited pages, grounding queries and provider-native intent/topic/citation-share dimensions

openai.primaryAiEvidence: OAI-SearchBot access eligibility plus separately observed ChatGPT referrals or citations when evidence exists

keyPrimitive.name: BraidGraph
keyPrimitive.purpose: Versioned evidence-to-change graph linking upstream sources, rule versions, target-site state, repository ownership, recommendations, transformations, verification and outcome evidence.

modules.name: Goose Map
modules.question: What does this site actually have and where is it owned?

modules.name: Goose Patch
modules.question: What can change safely and exactly?

modules.name: Goose Proof
modules.question: Did implementation pass, is it live, and what evidence followed?

modules.name: Goose Watch
modules.question: What needs attention now across the portfolio?

modules.name: Goose Connect
modules.question: What owner/provider evidence exists outside the repository?

durableDifferentiators: site-specific applicability instead of a universal readiness or AI visibility score
explicit owner-declared versus publicly observed truth boundaries
intent and page-job ownership before URL expansion
source-backed recommendation supply chain with freshness, supersession and retirement history
deterministic repository mutations with preconditions, rollback and PR-first delivery
deployment parity as a hard gate before measuring an intervention
separation of implementation proof from provider-native external outcome evidence
versioned evidence lineage and reverse impact through BraidGraph
negative and neutral experiment outcomes retained rather than filtered out

productBets.title: Portfolio Proof Board generated from committed evidence
Populate real owned-site Growth and controlled-cohort evidence
Harden provider-native Google/Bing/OpenAI/referral evidence semantics without a composite score
One problem-first first-run journey ending in a concise Get Found Brief
Scale portfolio Watch only after several trustworthy evidence loops exist

deprioritizedUntilProof: new top-level public modules without a demonstrated user job
new protocol adapters without a concrete blocked Goose workflow or interoperability failure
new AI-specific markup or files justified only by GEO folklore
indexable URL expansion that has not passed intent/page value gates
new composite readiness or AI visibility scores
